# Migration Intentions - v1.3.0

## Intentions

<!-- boilerstone:intentions:begin — generated by `pnpm boilerplate intentions sync`, do not edit -->

- [`00-drop-producer-only-workflows.md`](./00-drop-producer-only-workflows.md) — `migration` · `ci` — The project has no `Intention gate` or `Intention promote` workflow, neither check is required on the default branch, the `no-intention` label is not part of its repository script and settings doc, and `ci.yml` has no release-tag fixture step.
- [`01-nestjs-better-auth.md`](./01-nestjs-better-auth.md) — `breaking-manual` · `auth` — The API wires Better Auth into NestJS through `@thallesp/nestjs-better-auth`. The in-tree guard, decorators, service and module definition are gone. Every route requires a session unless it is marked `@AllowAnonymous()` or `@OptionalAuth()`.
